# Skills

Skill registries and guidance for extending OpenClaw capabilities.

## Architecture

- [Tools and skills](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools) - Learn how OpenClaw exposes tools and loads skills. 🎖️
  - Metadata: `documentation · official · free · active`; last verified 2026-08-12.
  - Risk: Tools and skills can access credentials and external systems.

## Development

- [OpenClaw Agent Skills](https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills) - Official version-controlled collection of reusable review validation transcript and contributor workflows for agents working on OpenClaw projects. 🎖️
  - Metadata: `skill-collection · official · free · active`; last verified 2026-09-05. [repository](https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills)
  - Risk: The installer writes or symlinks agent skill directories and individual workflows can inspect repositories and session exports while Beam can publish redacted coding sessions; audit and install only required skills.

## Registry

- [ClawHub skills](https://clawhub.ai/skills) - Browse published community skills and inspect their metadata before installation.
  - Metadata: `skill-registry · community · free · active`; last verified 2026-08-12.
  - Risk: Skills can execute code access credentials or call external services.

- [ClawHub source](https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub) - CLI and registry source for searching inspecting and installing skills. 🎖️
  - Metadata: `official-project · official · free · active`; last verified 2026-08-12. [repository](https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub)
  - Risk: Review package behavior and registry metadata before installation.

## Smart Home

- [Tuya Smart Control](https://github.com/tuya/tuya-openclaw-skills) - Tuya-maintained OpenClaw skill for querying and controlling supported smart-home devices and receiving device events through the Tuya end-user cloud API.
  - Metadata: `skill · third-party · freemium · watch`; last verified 2026-10-10. [repository](https://github.com/tuya/tuya-openclaw-skills)
  - Risk: The API key exposes home and device metadata and can permit physical device control camera captures notifications and renames; trial endpoints have quotas and may change so require confirmation for consequential actions.
